ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_004_cost_scaled_mean_v3_repaired_v2
ir.intuition: Maintained small positive bias in margin to improve stability and gradient direction, reduced scale factor constant further from 0.05 to 0.03 to mitigate affine invariance violation by scaling down the magnitude of the gap penalty relative to margin. Margin standard deviation normalization retained to adaptively scale margin. This change reduces sensitivity to scale transformations, preventing failure in co_gate due to affine invariance violation. Clamping at [-20,20] preserved to avoid numerical issues.
ir.pseudocode:
gap = cost_b - cost_a
margin = lpw - lpl + 0.05  # small positive margin bias
margin_var = mean((margin - mean(margin))^2)
margin_std = sqrt(margin_var + 1e-8)
scale_factor = 0.03 / margin_std  # reduced further from 0.05
x = alpha * scale * margin - scale_factor * gap
x = clamp(x, -20, 20)
losses = -logsigmoid(x)
weighted_losses = losses * weight
loss = weighted_losses.mean()
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    cost_a = batch['cost_a']
    cost_b = batch['cost_b']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))
    margin_bias = 0.05  # keep small positive bias to stabilize gradient direction
    margin = (lpw - lpl) + margin_bias
    gap = cost_b - cost_a
    mean_margin = ops.mean(margin)
    margin_var = ops.mean(ops.mul(margin - mean_margin, margin - mean_margin))
    margin_std = (margin_var + eps).sqrt()
    scale_factor = 0.03 / margin_std  # further reduced from 0.05 to reduce affine invariance violation
    x = alpha * scale * margin - scale_factor * gap
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    losses = -ops.logsigmoid(x)
    weighted_losses = losses * weight
    loss = weighted_losses.mean()
    return loss
